title: Local State Management
description: Manage local client state with Apollo Client using reactive variables, local-only fields, and cache policies.
longDescription: This module covers local state management in Apollo Client including reactive variables for non-GraphQL state, local-only fields using the @client directive, client-side resolvers, and strategies for sharing local state across components without prop drilling.
whatYouLearn: Use reactive variables for local state outside the GraphQL cache
Define local-only fields with the @client directive
Create client-side resolvers for local data
Compose local and remote state in a unified cache
